groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Three strokes on the left: what the hand does.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 木 tree + 大 big + 手 hand
chars.story: Hand over hand up tree after tree, up the big slope: climb.
chars.note: Also 'to link oneself to' a powerful person: 攀附.

chars.story: Hands lay the goods out flat on the ground: a vendor stall.
chars.note: Also 'share a cost': 分摊. Traditional 攤.

chars.story: A hand pressing someone down into his seat: held back.
chars.note: In modern prose mostly 挫折 'setback'.

chars.story: A hand draws it back from the edge: draw back.
Two hands pull the paper apart: tear apart.
A hand flicks the dipper to shake the drops loose: it trembles.

groups.title: calls 口
groups.note: Small mouth noises written with a 口 on the left.

chars.story: A mouth making a low noise through the nose: a hum.
chars.note: Also a snort of scorn: humph.

chars.story: A mouth opens a little in surprise.
chars.note: An interjection; also a light sentence-ending particle. Traditional 喲.

chars.story: A mouth lets out a long breath: alas.
chars.note: An interjection: 'ah', 'alas'.

chars.story: The edge of the mouth: the lip.
A mouth that blurts out a sudden 乍 question: how come?
chars.note: In northern speech it stands for 怎么 'how': 咋办 'what to do?'. Its dictionary sense 'bite' survives in 咋舌.

chars.story: The everyday drink for the mouth: beer.
chars.note: Only in 啤酒 and words built on it.

chars.story: The cord drawn tight on a bow, that hums when plucked: a bow string.
An instrument you blow with the mouth: a horn.
chars.note: Only in words like 喇叭.

chars.story: A cry that rises from inside the chest: a battle cry.
chars.note: Also a sentence-ending particle.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: waves and fluids.

chars.story: Water held back by a belt: stagnant.
chars.note: Traditional 滯.

chars.story: Water heaped high: a big wave.
chars.note: Traditional 濤.

chars.story: Birds gather along the water: the Huai river.
chars.note: Only a river name.

chars.story: Water pressed out of the fruit after ten squeezes: juice.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 桼 tree sap
chars.story: Sap running from a tree: lacquer.
A heart haunted by a ghost: ashamed.
A heart already full to the brim: impassioned.
An eye that watches the road for someone's return: hope for.
An eye fixed on one small sprout: aim.
An eye nailed to one spot: stare.
The arch that sits over the eye: eyebrow.

groups.title: the body 月
groups.note: Flesh on the left or below.

chars.story: The low organ in the flesh: the spleen.
chars.note: 脾气 'temper' is the common word.

chars.story: A hand-sized organ in the flesh: the kidney.
chars.note: Traditional 腎.

chars.story: The branches of the body: limbs.

chars.parts: ⺮ bamboo + 月 flesh + 力 strength
chars.story: Bamboo-like fibre in the flesh that gives it strength: tendon.
chars.note: 脑筋 'brains, mind' is common.

chars.story: A head that will not turn: stubborn.
chars.note: Traditional 頑: 頁 became 页.

chars.story: A bent head over a long stretch of field: a hectare.
chars.note: In 顷刻 it means 'a moment'. Traditional 頃.

chars.story: A person who gave up ordinary life: a monk.
The person society needs for learning: a Confucian scholar.
chars.note: Also 'Confucian': 儒家 is the Analects school.

chars.parts: 工 bar + 人 dancer + 人 dancer
chars.story: Two figures dance either side of a pole: the shaman.
A woman who belongs to the emperor himself: a concubine.
A gentleman with feathery white hair: an old man.

chars.parts: 卩 kneeling man + 皀 bowl + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: Two officials kneel facing each other across a feast bowl: high officials.
chars.note: Old term of address, and of endearment.

chars.story: Money goes short and the price is cut: demote.
chars.note: Traditional 貶.

chars.story: A hand that holds wealth and uses it well: a worthy person.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'worthy'. 賢 lost its 臣 and became 贤.

chars.story: Earth piled on earth on earth: a rampart.
chars.note: Traditional 壘.

chars.story: Earth heaped to hold back the water: a dam.
chars.note: Traditional 壩.

chars.story: A low spot ringed by a bank of earth.
chars.note: Today mostly 船坞 'dock, shipyard'. Traditional 塢.

chars.story: A step of earth you must cross: a threshold, and a pit if you miss it.
chars.note: 坎坷 'bumpy' can mean a hard life.

groups.title: lean-to 广
groups.note: A lean-to roof over the top and left.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 比 side by side
chars.story: Two people side by side under a lean-to: shelter.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 相 each other
chars.story: Rooms face one another across a courtyard: the side rooms.
chars.note: Traditional 廂: 广 became 厂.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 肀 hand + 用 use
chars.story: Under a plain roof, used day in day out: mediocre.
chars.note: 平庸 'mediocre' is the common word. 中庸 is a Confucian ideal.

chars.story: A bit of metal with a head and a point: a nail.
chars.note: Traditional 釘.

chars.story: A piece of metal cut like a crescent moon: a door key.
chars.note: Traditional 鑰.

chars.story: A long soft run of silk: soft and continuous.
chars.note: Traditional 綿.

chars.story: Thin silk with little thread: fine yarn.
chars.note: Traditional 紗.

chars.story: Words that leave you lost: a riddle.
chars.note: Traditional 謎: 言 became 讠.

chars.story: Words that wander far from the truth: absurd.
chars.note: Traditional 謬.

chars.story: The mouth explains one thing through another: a metaphor.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'understand'. Modern use is 'metaphor', as in 比喻.

chars.story: A cloth put up in public: a notice.
chars.note: Also an invitation card: 请帖.

chars.story: Food enough to spare, and a life spared too.
chars.note: Traditional 饒.

chars.story: Food sent to a guest: give a gift.
chars.note: Traditional 饋.

groups.title: geese and the sea
groups.note: Birds, and treasures of the shore.

chars.story: A big bird that follows the river: a wild goose.
chars.note: Also 'great'. Traditional 鴻.

chars.story: A big white bird that struts as if it owned the pond: a goose.
chars.note: Traditional 鵝.

chars.story: A fish-like creature wrapped in its shell: abalone.
chars.note: Also a surname, Bao. Traditional 鮑.

chars.story: Jade-like stems standing like tablets under the sea: coral.
chars.note: Only in 珊瑚 'coral', as the first half of the word.

chars.story: An insect eating its way in: erode.
chars.note: Traditional 蝕.

chars.story: The old stuff insects build combs from: wax.
chars.note: Traditional 蠟.

chars.story: The bristle at a grass seed's tip.
chars.note: Mostly met in 芒果 'mango' and 光芒 'rays'.

chars.story: The heart of a rush: its pith.
chars.note: 芯片 'microchip' is the word to know.

chars.story: Grass thrown over a thing to hide it: cover over.
A tree with fruit small and red as a baby's cheek: cherry.
chars.note: Traditional 櫻.

chars.story: A length of wood: a rod.
A hollowed log for feed: a trough.
chars.note: 跳槽 'job-hop' and 吐槽 'complain' are everyday.

groups.title: fire 火 灬
groups.note: Fire on the left or below.

chars.story: Fire in the forest: burn down.
A fire fit for an emperor: brilliant.
chars.note: Only in 辉煌.

chars.story: Fire beneath, light all around: splendid.
chars.note: Mostly 熙熙攘攘, and the Kangxi emperor's name.

groups.title: grain
groups.note: Rice in the field and on the plate.

chars.story: The grain that stands in flooded fields: paddy rice.
Cooked rice clings to everything: stick to.
chars.note: 复制粘贴 is 'copy and paste'.

chars.story: Fired clay hard as tile: porcelain.
A dish you pour things out of: a basin.
A length of bamboo hollow all the way through: a tube.
A foot comes down on it: step on.
A horse at full speed: gallop.
chars.note: Traditional 馳.

chars.story: A paper ticket carried off by the wind: flutter.
chars.note: Traditional 飄.

chars.story: Wings spread wide: glide.
Pieces drawn together like crystals of ice: gather together.
chars.note: Traditional 湊.

chars.story: Walking on, you run into someone: meet by chance.
A fruit wrapped inside clothing: wrap around.
chars.note: 衣 is split in two, with 果 tucked inside.

chars.parts: 土 earth + 口 mouth + 衣 clothes
chars.story: A long robe trailing to the ground: a long robe.
chars.note: Mostly a surname, Yuan.

chars.story: Drum beats rolling out: the Peng family.
chars.note: A surname.

chars.parts: - two mouths joined end to end
chars.story: Two mouths linked end to end: a pitchpipe.
chars.note: Mostly a surname, Lü.

groups.title: character
groups.note: Five ways a person or place can be.

chars.story: The old one above, the child below, carrying him: filial.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'filial'. Same shape; in modern speech 孝顺.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 页 head + 刀 knife
chars.story: Under the roof one head is left, the rest are gone: scant.
chars.note: Also 'widowed'.

chars.story: A person who stands out in a crowd: eminent.
chars.note: In modern prose mostly 'handsome': 英俊.

chars.story: A roof and no one else to speak with: lonesome.
chars.note: Only seen after 寂: 寂寞.

chars.story: A brush that runs on without limit: wanton.
chars.note: Also the formal written 'four'.

chars.parts: 行 road split round 水 water
chars.story: Water spreading out between the sides of a road: spread.
A small gate on a pipe: a valve.
chars.note: Also a powerful clique: 军阀. Traditional 閥.

chars.story: A big man with a bow comes through and levels everything: raze.
chars.note: Old word for non-Han peoples.

chars.story: A mouth that tastes only brine: salty.
chars.note: Also an old 'all', as in 咸阳 Xianyang. Traditional 鹹 for 'salty'.

chars.story: Standing until all strength is gone: exhausted.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 卩 kneeling man
chars.story: A man crouched under a cliff in trouble: distressed.

chars.parts: 尢 lame leg + 监 watch
chars.story: Limping while everyone watches: embarrassed.
chars.note: Only in 尴尬. Traditional 尷.

chars.story: A hidden sickness that keeps drawing you back: addiction.
chars.note: Traditional 癮.

sentences.en: I feel very lonely these days.
I'd like to go to Hawaii.
They're carrying out a book burning.
